description: Pinned sample artifact for the ARTIFACT-INFERENCE notebook's default path: the serving artifact the E2E notebook exports on its default path (support rows + fitted preprocessing; no model output).
producer: tools/build_sample_artifact.py: the E2E stage runner's stage_data + stage_validate and the package's fit + export_artifact_bundle, with tabdpt.TabDPTClassifier replaced by the fit-time preprocessing of tabdpt 1.2.0 (mean SimpleImputer + StandardScaler; no PCA basis); no checkpoint is read
e2e_cross_check: the E2E notebook's export stage prints matches_pinned_sample_artifact for its default path
data: scikit-learn load_breast_cancer (Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer, UCI; 569 rows), seeded stratified 80/20 split, seed 42
